description: Use when building Spring Boot applications with Neo4j using Spring Data Neo4j (SDN 7.x/8.x) — @Node entity mapping, @Relationship, @RelationshipProperties, Neo4jRepository, ReactiveNeo4jRepository, @Query annotations, application.yml configuration, projections, Neo4jClient, Neo4jTemplate, transactions, auditing, or Spring AI Neo4jVectorStore vector search. Does NOT handle raw Java driver code without Spring — use neo4j-driver-java-skill. Does NOT handle Cypher query authoring — use neo4j-cypher-skill. Does NOT handle driver version upgrades — use neo4j-migration-skill.
